title: Senior/Lead Data Engineer
description:
About Ameren Services (B&CS)
Ameren Services provides administrative support and services to Ameren Corporation and its operating companies, subsidiaries and affiliates. Ameren Services includes a wide range of skill sets and roles, from finance and legal experts to digital and cyber specialists, plus those charged with ensuring environmental compliance and operational safety. Together, we help execute a strategy that enables Ameren to deliver superior long-term value to customers, shareholders and the environment.

Our benefits include:

- Medical coverage on date of hire

- 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

- 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

- Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

- Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position

- Generates reports and regular datasets or report information for end-users, using system tools and database or data warehouse queries and scripts. May create specifications for reports based on business requests.

- Designs, develops and programs methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyze structured and unstructured, diverse sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement. Analyzes and models data to understand complex business issues and provide insight to decision makers. Integrates data from multiple sources to produce requested or required data elements. Programs and maintains reports, information dashboards, data generators, canned reports and other end-user information portals or resources.

- Leads enterprise-wide data integration, warehousing and modeling activities across platforms

- Uses best practices in data engineering, data warehouse development and integration with enterprise systems

Key responsibilities include:

- Analyzes data from multiple sources and negotiates differences in storage schema using the ETL process

- Researches, troubleshoots and resolves data issues impacting extract delivery

- Displays deep understanding of requirements regarding solutions, ensures data quality and match-back to core systems transaction results

- Identifies and documents process for building data models within a single complex area of Ameren’s business (e.g., Distribution Control Center, Transmission, Gas Supply)

- Assembles large and complex data sets; develops data models based on specifications using structured data sets

- Develops familiarity with emerging and complex automations and technologies that support business processes

- Collaborates with Data Scientists to ensure architectural and project specification needs are being met

- Conducts necessary data transformations to populate data into a warehouse table structure that is optimized for reporting

- Isolates and defines core reusable data assets that support the long-term business strategy for development efforts

- Reviews data analysis and data mapping logic; identifies recurring causes for defects and works proactively to resolve issues; reviews fixes with the data governance teams

- Manages delivery of projects in partnership with business stakeholders by demonstrating a deep understanding of the business needs and how technical analysis can produce solutions

- Translates complex business requirements and technical designs into modeling/warehousing solutions aligned to business goals that deliver measurable value to the organization

- Designs and develops data models that provide solutions to business problems in alignment with enterprise architecture direction and design standards

- Understands the Digital organization’s objectives, and the impact on own projects; contributes to development of new data engineering strategies

- Reaches across multiple functions to implement the models into production and monitors their performance

- Demonstrates strong working knowledge of agile software development processes and the development lifecycle; liaises with scrum masters and coaches to move projects forward

- Coaches less experienced co-workers and provides feedback to enhance skills and knowledge

Qualifications - Senior Data Engineer

- Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in mathematics, statistics, computer science or business

- 5+ years of relevant experience required

Qualifications - Lead Data Engineer

- Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in mathematics, statistics, computer science or business

- 7+ years of relevant experience required

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

- Strong knowledge and experience in building and optimizing data pipelines, architectures, and datasets from structured datasets

- Strong knowledge of data organization and design principles for enterprise data warehouses (EDW), data marts and data lakes

- Demonstrated ability to build processes that support data transformation, structures, metadata, accuracy checking and workload management

- Strong knowledge of cloud architecture

- Strong knowledge of big data querying tools

- Strong understanding of agile and project methodologies and processes

- Strong analytical and creative thinking to address complex business problems

Additional Information
Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include a leadership assessment process.  Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

#LI-Hybrid

Compensation Range:
$105,100.00 - $204,400.00

* This pay range encompasses multiple levels of the role. Career level and compensation depends upon applicant’s credentials.

At Ameren, base salary is one component of a competitive compensation package for employees. Our pay ranges are broad to allow for movement within our organization and to accommodate different skill sets and levels of expertise. We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the base salary offered. Roles are eligible for additional rewards including annual incentive payments based on individual and company performance.

title: Senior Program Supervisor, Demand Response
description:
About Ameren Missouri
Ameren Missouri has been providing electric and gas service for more than 100 years, and our electric rates are among the lowest in the nation. Ameren Missouri's mission is to power the quality of life for our 1.2 million electric and 132,000 natural gas customers in central and eastern Missouri. Our service area covers 64 counties and more than 500 communities including the greater St. Louis area.

Our benefits include:

- Medical coverage on date of hire

- 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

- 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

- Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

- Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position
The Senior Program Supervisor, Demand Response is an internal consultant leading advancements of Ameren Missouri’s Demand Response implementation contractors and programs.

Key responsibilities include:

- Oversees the most critical, complex or largest demand response programs, including supervision of external implementation contractors as required.

- Responsible for the full lifecycle of program development from regulatory filings through implementation, budget management, and goal attainment.

- Leads report outs on program performance and key insights with regulators, business leaders, and other external stakeholders.

- Create and implement continuous improvement with emphasis on improving the customer experience.

- Support the development of demand response strategy, including new regulatory and operational frameworks, identifying declining and emerging technologies, and delivery channel opportunities, and lead the incorporation of those insights and developments into portfolio plans.

- Lead the development of program and portfolio plans as well as contribute to Commission approval; which may include expert witness testimony.

- Acts as an informal leader and consultant within the group as well as provide mentoring for less experienced team members.

- Uses exceptional knowledge of Demand Side Management regulatory structures (Missouri Energy Efficiency Investment Act, demand response and energy efficiency regulatory rules, approved regulatory filings and associated tariffs, etc.) to develop and execute strategic insights.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university required. Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or similar background preferred. Advanced degree preferred.

A minimum of seven years of experience in managing demand response or energy efficiency programs is required. Project Management Professional is required or achieved within 12 months. Demonstrated experience leading demand response programs from regulatory filing through full operational launch, including program design, vendor contracting, and cross-functional internal coordination with billing, metering, and customer service, and ultimately goal attainment strongly preferred . Experience in MISO or ISO registration and settlement for Demand Response programs is strongly preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

- Experience in leading contract development and execution.

- Experience leading external stakeholder interactions on complex topics.

- Strong decision-making, problem solving, analytical, and computational skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with critical time deadlines.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills (public speaking and written).

- Strong relationship building skills.

- Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

Additional Information
Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include a leadership assessment process.  Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

$111,100.00 - $172,200.00

title: GIS Co-op (Real Estate)
description:
Ameren is a leader in the energy industry, and our transformation toward more clean, renewable energy is also  transforming other industries and infrastructure in our communities.  As a regional company serving local customers, we not only serve our communities, we're a part of them. This isn't just a job. At Ameren, we invest in you, so you can power the quality of life you want.

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular, full-time employees.

About The Position
Ameren Services provides administrative support and services to Ameren Corporation and its operating companies, subsidiaries and affiliates. Nearly 1,400 employees serve the company with business planning, communications, diversity, financial support, human resources, information technology, legal counsel, and safety and supply services.
Student will work in GIS environment learning from engineers, designers or mapping personnel as they help support GIS projects. Key responsibilities include:

The co-op will be responsible for mapping Ameren's property rights ("interests") in ArcGIS Pro and delivering those mapped interests to Ameren Real Estate's GIS Technician.  This individual may be asked to provide some level of analysis of Ameren's interests or utilize GIS tools to identify property rights for members of the Real Estate Department.  This individual will be trained to:

- Use Ameren Real Estate's database to locate interests

- Understand legal documents pertaining to Real Estate, Read legal descriptions

- Map interests in ArcGIS Pro.

Available Opportunities:

- January – August 2027 Spring Co-op

- Reviewing GIS data for Quality Control and Quality Assurance purposes

- Visiting sites in field to collect data and verify Ameren records

- Interacting with Ameren contractors to evaluate/confirm the validity of data provided to Ameren

- Documenting work practices utilized to gather, evaluate and record GIS data

- Assisting with updates to Ameren data

Qualifications
Current student status pursuing a degree in GIS, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or related field from an accredited college or university required.  Must have a minimum of 2.5 GPA but, 3.0 GPA is preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will:

- Knowledge and/or use of Esri ArcPro GIS is highly preferred.

- Exceptional with Microsoft Office applications.

-  The candidate must be willing to engage and learn real estate in addition to GIS.

-  The candidate must be able to identify, work through, and make decisions with incomplete information.

- Solid part-time work history preferred

- Work effectively as part of a team

- Demonstrate creative problem solving and proactive learning, with good analytical, management, communication, and human relations skills.

- Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to articulate clearly

- Have the ability to perform multiple tasks within given time constraints with little to no oversight.

- Be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the salary offered.

About The Position

- Designs, develops, tests, debugs and implements application, software and/or operating system components, software tools, and utilities; conducts performance testing.

- Ensures that system improvements are successfully implemented and monitored to guarantee availability and increase efficiency.

- Completes technical documentation for multiple functions, including but not limited to testing, QA, training, troubleshooting, operating, and/or procedures for installation and maintenance.

Key responsibilities include:

- Implements and tests complex code changes to fix identified defects in existing software products

- Adds enhancements to new/future software releases

- Demonstrates strong knowledge of on premise solutions and cloud-based solutions; executes on cloud-based configuration plans for new systems/technologies

- Assists in performing root cause analysis and interprets the results; provides input into action plan (e.g., provides input into prioritization of offensive/customer-facing issues and defensive/internally focused backlogs)

- Independently handles/solves software/systems monitoring issues
